Community — Free Forever
↑ top

The Community tier gives you full access to the core — the same deterministic pipeline that powers every tier above it. There are no artificial limitations, no trial periods, and no feature gates on the architecture itself.

Build production-ready applications with a state engine that guarantees predictable transitions, reactive updates, and zero side effects — right out of the box.

No Credit Card Required

Install from npm and start building immediately. The Community tier is free for individuals, open-source projects, and teams evaluating the platform.

What's Included

  • Core state engine — deterministic pipeline with zero-boilerplate setup
  • Reactive signal system — fine-grained reactivity without manual subscriptions
  • Local state persistence — persist and restore application state across sessions
  • Chrome DevTools — inspect state, visualize FeatureCells, and debug in real time
  • Time-travel debugging — step through state history and replay transitions
  • TypeScript-native — full type safety with zero configuration
  • Community support — GitHub issues and Discord

The Community tier is not a demo. It is the same core architecture used in production by Pro and Enterprise customers. When you're ready for advanced tooling, upgrade without changing a single line of application code.

Pro — $299 per Project
↑ top

The Pro tier is designed for teams that ship to production and need tooling that matches the seriousness of their work. One payment. One project. Lifetime access.

Pro unlocks encrypted persistence, advanced debugging, telemetry instrumentation, and the full extensibility layer — everything a team needs to build, monitor, and scale production applications with confidence.

Lifetime License

The Pro license is a one-time purchase per project. No subscriptions, no renewals, no per-seat pricing. Your team gets permanent access to every Pro feature.

Everything in Community, Plus

  • Encrypted state persistence — AES-256-GCM encryption for all persisted state
  • Secure storage adapters — pluggable adapters for IndexedDB, custom backends, and more
  • Plugin system — extend the pipeline with behaviors and add-ons
  • Cross-tab synchronization — keep state consistent across browser tabs
  • Distributed state monitoring — leader/follower tab awareness
  • Advanced DevTools — FeatureCell visualization, pipeline visualization, and advanced state debugging
  • Telemetry metrics — pipeline execution timing, FeatureCell performance, and logging exporters

Pro is the right choice for startups, product teams, and agencies that need production-grade state management without the overhead of an enterprise contract.

Enterprise — Built for Scale
↑ top

Enterprise is for organizations where state management is not just a developer concern — it's an operational, security, and compliance requirement. When your application state touches revenue systems, regulated data, or mission-critical workflows, you need guarantees that go beyond code quality.

Enterprise provides SLA-backed support, advanced security controls, compliance documentation, and deployment flexibility for the most demanding environments.

Custom Pricing

Enterprise contracts are tailored to the size and needs of your organization. Pricing starts at $10,000/year and scales based on project count, support level, and compliance requirements. Contact us to discuss your needs.

Frequently Asked Questions
↑ top

Can I use the Community tier in production?

Yes. The Community tier includes the full deterministic pipeline and is production-ready. There are no time limits or feature restrictions on the core architecture.

What does "per project" mean for Pro?

A project is a single deployable application. If you ship three separate applications, each one requires its own Pro license. There is no per-seat or per-developer cost.

Is the Pro license really lifetime?

Yes. One payment gives you permanent access to all Pro features for that project. Future updates to Pro features are included at no additional cost.

What if I need Enterprise features for just one project?

Enterprise contracts cover your entire organization. If you have a single high-stakes project that requires SLA support, compliance documentation, or advanced security controls, contact us to discuss a plan that fits.

Do I need to change my code when upgrading tiers?

No. Every tier uses the same core API. Upgrading from Community to Pro or Enterprise adds capabilities without requiring changes to your existing application code.

Is training available?

Yes. offers public bootcamps, private corporate training, and a developer certification program. Learn more about training.
